module: Generates vehicle groups by performance class (S, A, B, C, D) for the core_multiSpawn system (opponents, races). Walks through all Car/Truck models and their configs, filters by model, config and config type, keeps those whose class (gameplay_vehiclePerformance.getClassFromConfig) matches, then shuffles the result. Also provides an AI aggression coefficient per class.
notes: Aggression coefficients: S 1, A 0.9, B 0.8, C 0.7, D 0.6; default class B.
Default filters: excluded models atv, utv, us_semi, midtruck, citybus, racetruck, rockbouncer, simple_traffic; excluded config types Police, Service, Powerglow.

With performanceIndexTarget, keeps only configs within the ±performanceIndexWindow window (5 by default); if none, takes the 10 closest. If the group remains empty, a fallback entry {model='midsize'} is added.
The "smart shuffle" interleaves models to avoid successive duplicates of the same model.
The mode argument ("default" or "drag") is read but has no effect in the code.

getAggressionMultiplier.desc: Returns the AI aggression coefficient for a class.

returns.desc: Coefficient (1 if the class is unknown).

generateGroup.desc: Builds a vehicle group of a given class, usable by core_multiSpawn.
